# Vantis CPA

> Vantis CPA is a Florida-based tax and accounting firm serving individuals, business owners, real estate investors, and clients with international ties. The firm provides proactive tax strategy, tax return preparation, and full-service accounting (bookkeeping, payroll, and sales tax), working remotely with clients across Florida, the United States, and abroad.

Key facts:

- Led by Jose Cornejo, CPA (Florida license AC60024), Master of Taxation, member of the AICPA and FICPA
- Focus areas: individual tax, business tax (S-corps, C-corps, partnerships, sole proprietors), international tax, and real estate tax
- International specialties: U.S. expats, foreign-owned U.S. LLCs, foreign investors in U.S. real estate, U.S. persons with foreign accounts and companies, and Latin America cross-border planning
- Works with clients remotely; no office visit required
- Contact: https://vantiscpa.com/contact/

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://vantiscpa.com/services/): Individual tax, business tax, international tax, and full-suite accounting support from entity formation through ongoing operations
- [Individual Tax](https://vantiscpa.com/services/individual-tax/): Returns and year-round planning for people with W-2, 1099, K-1, rental, equity compensation, and investment income
- [Business Tax](https://vantiscpa.com/services/business-tax/): Business returns, entity structure, and planning for partnerships, S-corps, C-corps, and sole proprietors
- [International Tax](https://vantiscpa.com/services/international-tax/): FBAR, FATCA, Form 5471, Form 5472, foreign tax credits, and pre-immigration planning for expats, foreign owners, and cross-border businesses
- [Full-Suite Accounting](https://vantiscpa.com/services/full-suite/): Bookkeeping, payroll, and sales tax as one operating-services hub

## Tax Guides and Resources

- [Resource Hub](https://vantiscpa.com/resources/): Practical tax guides, planning insights, and compliance checklists
- [Individuals & Families](https://vantiscpa.com/resources/individual-tax/): Retirement account strategy, self-employed retirement plans, foreign gifts and inheritances, and filing deadlines
- [Business Owners](https://vantiscpa.com/resources/business-tax/): S-corp elections and reasonable salary, entity structure, Schedule C deductions, partnerships, and 1099-K reporting
- [Real Estate Owners](https://vantiscpa.com/resources/real-estate-tax/): 1031 exchanges, real estate professional status, short-term rental taxes, and foreign ownership of U.S. real estate
- [Foreign Business & Investors](https://vantiscpa.com/resources/foreign-investors/): Foreign-owned LLCs, Form 5472, Form 1120-F, FIRPTA, pre-immigration planning, and country-specific guidance
- [U.S. Persons with International Ties](https://vantiscpa.com/resources/international-tax/): Form 5471, PFICs and Form 8621, foreign gifts (Form 3520), tax treaties, and foreign tax credits
- [U.S. Expats Abroad](https://vantiscpa.com/resources/expats/): Physical presence test, FEIE vs. foreign tax credit, PFIC exposure, and country-specific filing considerations
- [Florida Tax Guides](https://vantiscpa.com/resources/florida/): Sales tax, forming an LLC, and the no-state-income-tax advantage

## Locations

- [Service Areas](https://vantiscpa.com/locations/): Serving Florida statewide (Miami, Tampa, Orlando, Fort Lauderdale, and more) and international and cross-border clients nationwide
